title: British gravity research memo stamped Wright-Patterson with missing pages

tellings.quote: the copy I saw was stamped right Patterson Air Force Base on it and it missed about like five pages like there's this big legend about the missing five pages about where it's like it was achieved in the mid-century in and then it cuts off

plain: A British memo on gravity research circulates with about five pages missing, says the researcher Greg Bishop. He says the copy he saw was stamped Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, in Ohio. According to Bishop, a legend surrounds the missing pages: the text seems to say something "was achieved in the mid-century" and then cuts off, which would mean someone got somewhere with controlling gravity decades ago.
